About BlockchainSpace

BlockchainSpace powers Southeast Asia’s communities with blockchain technology to provide secure and transparent community management, fostering trust and loyalty among its user base.

Its solution suite includes YEY, a cutting-edge toolkit powered by web3 technology. It also offers trademark programs, Guild Partner Program, Creator Circle, and community insights.

Since 2020, BlockchainSpace has empowered over 100 communities and raised over $20M from top investors, including Animoca Brands, CoinGecko, and Crypto.com Capital.
